title: MarketingAI
tagline: AI Marketing Agent is a smart automation tool that generates professional PDF marketing materials and Medium blog posts in seconds. It streamlines content creation, saving time while ensuring high-quality, engaging, and data-driven marketing assets for businesses of all sizes. 🚀
description: This project consists of two main AI-powered generators built with Python and Google's Gemini Pro model. The first generator creates comprehensive Medium-style blog posts with 2000+ words, multiple sections, and image suggestions. The second generator creates professional pitch decks with custom-styled slides using modern design principles. Both tools use environment variables for secure API key management and implement rate limiting and error handling. The project leverages Vercel's OG Image generation for creating visually appealing slides with gradients and modern typography, and uses FPDF for PDF generation. The code is structured modularly with separate functions for content generation, design creation, and file output handling.
how_its_made:
AI Marketing Agent

AI Marketing Agent is a simple yet powerful tool that automates marketing content creation. It helps businesses save time by generating high-quality PDF marketing materials and Medium blog posts with just a few clicks.
What It Does:

✅ PDF Generation for Marketing: Instantly create brochures, presentations, case studies, and reports in a professional PDF format.
✅ Medium Blog Post Generation: AI writes well-structured, engaging, and SEO-friendly blog posts tailored to your industry and target audience.
Who It's For:

    Startups & Small Businesses – Need quick, professional marketing content.
    Marketers & Agencies – Automate content creation for clients.
    Freelancers & Creators – Publish high-quality blog posts effortlessly.

Why Use It?

✔ Saves Time – No need to manually write content.
✔ AI-Optimized – Generates structured, high-quality materials.
✔ Instant Results – Get PDFs and blogs in seconds.

Effortless marketing content, powered by AI. 🚀
